description: This file defines the 'PermissionService' interface, which specifies methods for managing permissions within the system, such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and listing permissions based on various criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of permissions by name, implementation details not provided.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Lists all permissions, potentially throws a ServiceException.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a specific permission by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new permission or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with provided group IDs.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a specified group.
